blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur — Agusan del Sur is mobilizing calamity funds and preparing longer-term measures as a severe El Niño has damaged more than a third of the province’s agricultural crops and cut water levels in critical watersheds by nearly a third. The provincial government, municipal officials and civil society groups met Oct. 1 for a two-day El Niño Response Planning Workshop at the Provincial Learning Center in Patin-ay to draw up measures for agriculture, water supply, public health and power stability. The effort comes after the province was placed under a state of calamity through Sangguniang Panlalawigan Resolution No. […]...
